Definition: Shaaph, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Shaaph is the name of two Israelites, and the genealogy keeps them apart. One is the son of Jahdai, named among Regem, and Jotham, and Gesham, and Pelet, and Ephah. The other is Shaaph the father of Madmannah, born to Caleb's concubine Ephah, beside Sheva the father of Machbenah.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the two Shaaphs show how the record works: the same name twice, and the fathers named so the two men are not confused.
